lines.en: Snow White
Once upon a time in a kingdom very far away there lived a king and a queen.
lines.zh: 很久很久以前，在一个遥远的王国里，住着一位国王和一位王后。

lines.en: The king was handsome and kind Everybody loved him.
lines.zh: 国王英俊又善良，人人都喜欢他。

lines.en: But the real ruler of the kingdom was his wife...
lines.zh: 可王国真正的统治者是他的妻子……

lines.en: — the queen.
Before she became queen, she worked in the castle kitchen.
lines.zh: 在成为王后之前，她在城堡的厨房里干活。

lines.en: She was very poor.
But she was also very beautiful, and funny, and very good at Scrabble.
lines.zh: 可她也非常美丽，很风趣，而且特别会玩拼字游戏。

lines.en: So the king fell in love with her, and married her.
lines.zh: 于是国王爱上了她，娶她为妻。

lines.en: The king loved the queen very much.
But the queen was always afraid that the king would meet someone more beautiful.
lines.zh: 可王后总是害怕国王会遇到更美丽的人。

lines.en: Luckily, the queen had a magic mirror.
lines.zh: 幸运的是，王后有一面魔镜。

lines.en: The mirror saw everything and knew everything.
lines.zh: 这面镜子什么都看得见，什么都知道。

lines.en: Every day the queen looked at herself in the mirror, and asked: “Magic mirror on the wall, who is the most beautiful of all?
lines.zh: 每天王后都对着镜子看自己，然后问：“魔镜魔镜挂在墙上，谁是世界上最美丽的人？

lines.en: ” And the mirror replied: You are, my Queen!
You are the most beautiful woman in the whole world.
lines.zh: 您是世界上最美丽的女人。”

lines.en: ” The queen was happy.
She knew there was nobody in the world as beautiful as her.
lines.zh: 她知道，世界上没有谁比她更美丽。

lines.en: But one day everything changed.
The queen stood in front of the mirror and asked her usual question.
lines.zh: 王后站在镜子前，问出了她一贯的问题。

lines.en: “Magic mirror on the wall, who is the most beautiful of all?
lines.zh: “魔镜魔镜挂在墙上，谁是世界上最美丽的人？

lines.en: ” And the mirror replied: “You are very beautiful, my Queen.
lines.zh: ”镜子回答：“您很美丽，我的王后。

lines.en: But the most beautiful woman in the world is… ...
lines.zh: 可世界上最美丽的女人是……

lines.en: Snow White.
” The queen was shocked.
“Who is this Snow White?
” she asked the mirror.
“Snow White works in the castle kitchen.
lines.zh: “白雪公主在城堡的厨房里干活。

lines.en: She has hair as black as night, lips as red as roses, and skin as white as snow.
lines.zh: 她的头发像夜晚一样黑，嘴唇像玫瑰一样红，皮肤像雪一样白。

lines.en: As of… 8am this morning, she is a wee-bitty-bit more beautiful than you.
lines.zh: 从今天早上八点起，她比您美了那么一丁点。

lines.en: ” “ARRRGGHH!!
” yelled the queen.
She stomped her feet.
She pulled her hair.
Then she sat down and sobbed.
“I will lose everything!
” The queen was afraid, and that fear turned her heart cold and hard.
lines.zh: ”王后害怕了，这份恐惧让她的心变得又冷又硬。

lines.en: She called a trusted hunter to her room.
lines.zh: 她把一个信得过的猎人叫到房间。

lines.en: “Find the girl, Snow White,” she ordered.
lines.zh: “去找那个女孩，白雪公主，”她命令道。

lines.en: “Take her far, far away.
Take her deep into the woods.
” And then the queen looked deep into the hunter’s eyes.
lines.zh: ”然后王后深深地看着猎人的眼睛。

lines.en: “She must never come back.
” The hunter found Snow White, and took her into the forest.
lines.zh: ”猎人找到了白雪公主，把她带进了森林。

lines.en: When they reached the deepest, darkest part of the forest, the hunter stopped.
lines.zh: 当他们走到森林最深最暗的地方时，猎人停下了。

lines.en: “Go!
” he whispered.
“Run fast and far and don't ever go home!
” Snow White watched the hunter disappear.
lines.zh: ”白雪公主看着猎人消失在远处。

lines.en: “Well, I can’t go home now,” she muttered.
lines.zh: “唉，现在我回不了家了，”她嘀咕道。

lines.en: She looked around at the dark and silent forest.
lines.zh: 她环顾四周，森林又黑又静。

lines.en: It started to rain.
“But I can’t stay here either.
Ok feet, let’s go.
” Snow White ran and ran.
She ran across a stream, up a hill, and down into a dark valley.
lines.zh: 她蹚过小溪，爬上小山，又跑进一个幽暗的山谷。

lines.en: She ran all morning.
By midday her pale skin and rosy cheeks were covered in mud and scratches.
lines.zh: 到了中午，她白皙的皮肤和红润的脸颊沾满了泥巴和划痕。

lines.en: By early afternoon her long black hair was full of sticks and leaves.
lines.zh: 到了下午早些时候，她长长的黑发里全是树枝和树叶。

lines.en: By night, she was not beautiful anymore.
lines.zh: 到了晚上，她已经不美了。

lines.en: She was tired, hungry, and shivering with cold.
But then Snow White smelled woodsmoke in the air.
lines.zh: 就在这时，白雪公主闻到空气里有柴火烟的味道。

lines.en: She followed the smell and found a cottage in the woods.
lines.zh: 她顺着味道，在森林里找到了一间小屋。

lines.en: There was a warm, golden glow from the windows.
lines.zh: 窗子里透出温暖金色的光。

lines.en: She knocked on the door.
“Hello?
” She called out.
“Is anyone home?
” There was no answer.
She pushed the door open and went inside.
Inside the cottage were seven tiny beds, seven tiny chairs, and a roaring fire.
lines.zh: 小屋里有七张小床、七把小椅子，还有烧得正旺的炉火。

lines.en: A big table was covered with dirty dishes.
lines.zh: 一张大桌子上堆满了脏盘子。

lines.en: Snow White was very hungry and thirsty.
She found some bread, and ate the whole loaf.
lines.zh: 她找到一些面包，把整条都吃了。

lines.en: She found some milk, and drank the whole bottle.
lines.zh: 她找到一些牛奶，把整瓶都喝了。

lines.en: Then she sat in front of the fire to get warm.
lines.zh: 然后她坐在炉火前取暖。

lines.en: And just like that, she fell asleep.
When she woke up, there were seven dwarfs standing around her.
lines.zh: 她醒来时，身边站着七个小矮人。

lines.en: Snow White rubbed her eyes.
“Who are you?
” she said.
“This is OUR house!
” said one dwarf, angrily.
“Who are YOU?
” “Shhh, you'll scare her!
” said another.
“She’s a giant.
SHE scares ME!
” said yet another.
“Can I stay with you?"
asked Snow White.
"It seems I can't go home."
The dwarfs whispered amongst themselves.
lines.zh: 小矮人们互相低声商量。

lines.en: “Ok,” they agreed.
“But only if you help us wash the dishes.
We hate washing dishes!
” “It’s a deal,” said Snow White.
And so, Snow White found a new home with the seven dwarfs.
lines.zh: 就这样，白雪公主和七个小矮人一起有了新家。

lines.en: Every morning she washed the dishes.
And every morning, as the dwarfs left for work, they said “Be careful.
lines.zh: 每天早上小矮人们出门干活时都会说：“小心点。

lines.en: Don’t open the door for anyone...
And thank you for washing the dishes.
lines.zh: 还有，谢谢你帮我们洗碗。

lines.en: We really hate washing dishes.
lines.zh: 我们真的最讨厌洗碗了。”

lines.en: ” Back at the castle, the queen was feeling better.
lines.zh: 再说城堡里，王后心情好些了。

lines.en: She thought Snow White was gone forever.
lines.zh: 她以为白雪公主永远消失了。

lines.en: But she was still a little afraid.
“Come and play Scrabble with me, my love!
lines.zh: “亲爱的，来陪我玩拼字游戏吧！

lines.en: ” shouted the King from the bottom of the stairs.
“You can go first!
” “Maybe later, dearest,” replied the queen.
She stood in front of her magic mirror.
“Magic mirror on the wall, who is the most beautiful of all?
lines.zh: “魔镜魔镜挂在墙上，谁是世界上最美丽的人？

lines.en: ” The mirror replied: “You are very beautiful, my Queen.
lines.zh: ”镜子回答：“您很美丽，我的王后。

lines.en: But the girl Snow White is the most beautiful woman in the world.
lines.zh: 可那个叫白雪公主的女孩是世界上最美丽的女人。”

lines.en: ” “Snow White is ALIVE??
” shouted the queen.
“She is living with the seven dwarfs in the forest,” said the mirror.
lines.zh: “她住在森林里，和七个小矮人在一起，”镜子说。

lines.en: “Last night, she was not very beautiful.
But as of… 1pm today, she is more beautiful than you.
lines.zh: 可从今天下午一点起，她又比您美了。

lines.en: ” “RATS!
” shouted the queen.
She went to her closet and got her old coat and old boots.
lines.zh: 她走到衣柜前，拿出旧外套和旧靴子。

lines.en: “I’ll have to kill her myself!
” She ran out of the palace, jumped into her fastest carriage, and sped off towards the forest.
lines.zh: ”她跑出宫殿，跳上最快的马车，朝森林飞驰而去。

lines.en: Snow White was reading beside the fire when there was a knock on the door.
lines.zh: 白雪公主正在炉火边看书，忽然响起了敲门声。

lines.en: KNOCK!
KNOCK!
She peeked through the window.
There was a woman holding a basket of fruit.
lines.zh: 外面站着一个女人，手里拎着一篮水果。

lines.en: The woman had a beautiful face, but she was wearing an old dress and old boots.
lines.zh: 那个女人有张漂亮的脸，却穿着旧裙子和旧靴子。

lines.en: “FRUIT!
FRESH FRUIT!
APPLES AND BANANAS AND PEARS AND ORANGES!
” “Oh, I want some fruit…” thought Snow White.
lines.zh: ”“哦，我想吃点水果……”白雪公主心想。

lines.en: The woman saw Snow White through the window.
lines.zh: 那个女人透过窗子看见了白雪公主。

lines.en: “Hello dear!
” said the woman.
“Do you want some fruit?
I have delicious apples today...
lines.zh: 我今天有很好吃的苹果……

lines.en: ” “I love apples…” said Snow White.
“But I'm not supposed to open the door for anyone… … those apples might be poisoned.
lines.zh: “可我不能给任何人开门……那些苹果可能有毒。

lines.en: ” “Oh, how silly,” said the woman.
She cut an apple in half.
lines.zh: 她把一个苹果切成两半。

lines.en: “Here.
You can taste half, and I will eat the other half.
That way you know it’s NOT poisoned.
lines.zh: 这样你就知道它没毒了。

lines.en: ” Snow White opened the door.
The woman gave one half of the apple to Snow White, and ate the other half.
lines.zh: 女人把一半苹果给了白雪公主，自己吃了另一半。

lines.en: When Snow White saw the woman eating the juicy apple, her mouth watered.
lines.zh: 白雪公主看见女人吃着多汁的苹果，馋得流口水。

lines.en: She couldn’t stop herself.
She took a big bite of the apple.
lines.zh: 她大大地咬了一口苹果。

lines.en: Almost immediately, Snow White fell to the ground.
lines.zh: 几乎立刻，白雪公主就倒在了地上。

lines.en: The apple was poisoned, but only on one half!
lines.zh: 苹果有毒，但只有一半有毒！

lines.en: The queen sighed with relief.
Quickly, she got back into her carriage and rode back to the castle.
lines.zh: 她赶紧坐上马车，回城堡去了。

lines.en: When the dwarfs arrived home, they found Snow White lying on the floor.
lines.zh: 小矮人们回到家，发现白雪公主躺在地上。

lines.en: They yelled in her ears.
They tickled her feet.
They poured cold water on her face.
But she didn't wake up.
“Is she ...
dead?
” asked one dwarf.
“She doesn’t seem to be alive…” said a second.
lines.zh: “她看起来不像活着的样子……”另一个说。

lines.en: And so the dwarfs made a glass coffin for their beloved friend.
lines.zh: 于是小矮人们为他们亲爱的朋友做了一口玻璃棺材。

lines.en: They set it on a table in a beautiful part of the forest, surrounded by flowers.
lines.zh: 他们把棺材放在森林里一处美丽地方的桌子上，四周摆满了花。

lines.en: Snow White lay there for over a year: Through spring, summer, autumn, and winter.
lines.zh: 白雪公主在那里躺了一年多：经历了春、夏、秋、冬。

lines.en: One day, a prince from a different kingdom was walking through the forest with his dog.
lines.zh: 一天，另一个王国的王子带着他的狗在森林里散步。

lines.en: He saw Snow White’s strange glass coffin.
lines.zh: 他看见了白雪公主那口奇怪的玻璃棺材。

lines.en: He brushed off the leaves and saw Snow White inside.
lines.zh: 他拂去落叶，看见了里面的白雪公主。

lines.en: Just then, he tripped over his dog and knocked the coffin off the table!
lines.zh: 就在这时，他被自己的狗绊了一跤，把棺材从桌上撞了下来！

lines.en: Snow White rolled out of the coffin and onto the grass.
lines.zh: 白雪公主从棺材里滚出来，滚到了草地上。

lines.en: “Oh no!
Oh dear!
Oh...
fffffffiddlesticks!"
the prince shouted.
But then an amazing thing happened: The piece of poisoned apple that was stuck in Snow White’s throat fell out, and she began to cough.
lines.zh: 可接着，一件奇妙的事发生了：卡在白雪公主喉咙里的那块毒苹果掉了出来，她开始咳嗽。

lines.en: The prince rushed to help her.
“Apples…” she coughed.
“I beg your pardon?
” said the prince.
“No ..
more ..
apples!
That night, the queen stood in front of the magic mirror and asked her question.
lines.zh: 那天晚上，王后站在魔镜前，问出了她的问题。

lines.en: “Magic mirror on the wall, who is the most beautiful of all?
lines.zh: “魔镜魔镜挂在墙上，谁是世界上最美丽的人？

lines.en: ” And to her surprise, the mirror said: “You are very beautiful, my Queen.
lines.zh: ”让她吃惊的是，镜子说：“您很美丽，我的王后。

lines.en: But...
Snow White is again the most beautiful woman in the world.
lines.zh: 白雪公主又是世界上最美丽的女人了。”

lines.en: ” “WHAAAAAAT?????
” screamed the queen.
And in her anger, she picked up a shoe and threw it at the mirror.
lines.zh: 她一气之下，抓起一只鞋朝镜子扔过去。

lines.en: The mirror smashed into a thousand pieces, and the magic inside it was released.
lines.zh: 镜子碎成了上千片，里面的魔法也随之消散。

lines.en: “NOOOOOOOOOO!
” screamed the queen.
She collapsed on the floor and fell into a deep sleep.
lines.zh: 她瘫倒在地上，沉沉地睡了过去。

lines.en: While she slept, the queen had a strange dream.
lines.zh: 睡着的时候，王后做了一个奇怪的梦。

lines.en: In her dream, she was dancing in hot iron shoes.
lines.zh: 梦里，她穿着烧红的铁鞋跳舞。

lines.en: Her feet burned and burned but she couldn’t stop dancing.
lines.zh: 她的脚烧啊烧，可她停不下来。

lines.en: When the Queen woke up from this terrible dream, it was morning.
lines.zh: 王后从这个可怕的梦中醒来时，已经是早晨了。

lines.en: The sun was shining, and the Queen felt...
different.
The magic mirror's spell was broken, so she didn't feel anxious or jealous anymore.
lines.zh: 魔镜的咒语被打破了，她不再焦虑，也不再嫉妒。

lines.en: She felt free.
She went downstairs to find her husband.
She really wanted to play Scrabble.
lines.zh: 她很想玩一局拼字游戏。

lines.en: And what happened to Snow White?
lines.zh: 那白雪公主后来怎么样了呢？

lines.en: The dwarfs were very happy to see Snow White alive.
lines.zh: 小矮人们看到白雪公主还活着，高兴极了。

lines.en: They invited the prince for dinner.
When the prince learned that nobody liked washing dishes, he bought them a dishwasher.
lines.zh: 王子得知没人喜欢洗碗，就给他们买了一台洗碗机。

lines.en: Everybody lived happily ever after.
lines.zh: 大家都过上了幸福的生活。
